caption: A simple shift in planning can save hours. These prompts turn busywork into high-impact choices. Save this and try one today. Which task will you reframe first this week? #ai #productivity #planning

slides.title: Impact-First Planning
slides.body: You're planning by tasks, not impact. Here's five prompts to reframe work around value and urgency.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose Impact
slides.body: Diagnose Impact: From [PLACEHOLDER], pick top 3 high-impact items; output: 1) name, 2) impact 1-5, 3) deadline.

slides.title: 2. Improve Clarity
slides.body: Improve Clarity: For each selected task, translate into measurable objective; output: Task name - objective outcome - success metric.

slides.title: 3. Schedule Priorities
slides.body: Schedule Priorities: Build a one-week plan focusing on high-impact tasks with dependencies; output daily focus list; include a 1-hour buffer.

slides.title: 4. Risk & Bottlenecks
slides.body: Identify top 2 blockers per task; propose mitigation steps; output: task - blocker - mitigation; deadline optional.

slides.title: 5. Quick Check
slides.body: Run a 5-minute reality check: would you still choose this under different constraints? Yes/No + justification.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Impact-first planning makes every hour count; adopt the five prompts as a repeatable weekly routine.
